findings.title: OptimizedCursorPaginator breaks datetime ordering
findings.body: In src/sentry/api/paginator.py OptimizedCursorPaginator.get_item_key does math.floor/ceil directly on getattr(item, self.key) and value_from_cursor returns cursor.value as int. The only caller in src/sentry/api/endpoints/organization_auditlogs.py uses order_by="-datetime", so the key is a datetime object. math.floor(datetime) raises TypeError and filtering a datetime column against int 0 in build_queryset is a type mismatch. Consequence: any request with optimized_pagination=true crashes with 500 or paginates incorrectly instead of behaving like DateTimePaginator.

findings.title: Negative queryset slice crashes instead of paginating
findings.body: In src/sentry/api/paginator.py OptimizedCursorPaginator.get_result allows start_offset=cursor.offset when enable_advanced_features and offset<0, then does queryset[start_offset:stop]. Django QuerySets explicitly reject negative indexing with AssertionError/ValueError, they do not wrap like Python lists. The comment claiming Django handles negative slicing automatically is false. Consequence: an attacker-controlled cursor string like value:-10:0 reaches an unhandled exception and returns 500, a remotely triggerable availability issue.

findings.title: Unknown paginate kwarg enable_advanced_features
findings.body: In src/sentry/api/endpoints/organization_auditlogs.py the optimized branch calls self.paginate(..., paginator_cls=OptimizedCursorPaginator, enable_advanced_features=True). Base endpoint paginate does not define that parameter and does not forward arbitrary kwargs to the paginator constructor in the established codebase. Consequence: the optimized path either raises TypeError for unexpected keyword argument returning 500, or silently drops the flag so the paginator never actually enables the intended mode, making the branch dead/broken.

findings.title: Global BasePaginator offset clamp is inconsistent and wrong
findings.body: In src/sentry/api/paginator.py BasePaginator.get_result was changed for all APIs from queryset[offset:offset+limit+extra] to start_offset=max(0,offset) for forward cursors but keeps raw offset for is_prev cursors and for the later check len(results)==offset+limit+extra. Other paginators in the same file (OffsetPaginator, ChainPaginator, CombinedQuerysetPaginator) reject offset<0 with BadPaginationError (400). Consequence: this global change silently coerces invalid forward cursors to page 0 instead of 400, still crashes for is_prev negative offsets, and miscomputes has_more when clamping because the length check uses the unclamped offset.

findings.title: New paginator and endpoint branch have no tests
findings.body: In src/sentry/api/paginator.py a new OptimizedCursorPaginator class and a modified BasePaginator path plus a new optimized_pagination branch in OrganizationAuditLogsEndpoint were added with no unit or API tests. Consequence: the datetime-key crash, negative-slice crash, and paginate-kwarg mismatch above are uncaught, and future changes to global pagination have no regression coverage.
